image_description: A low-angle shot of two street signs mounted on a dark metal pole against a building facade. The left sign is a colorful, artistic poster-style sign with abstract shapes and text that appears to be in Hebrew or a stylized font. The right sign is a standard white rectangular traffic sign with black text, also appearing to be in Hebrew, but the characters are distorted and nonsensical. There is additional blurry text visible on the building wall in the background.

The physical connection between the signs and the pole is vague. The right sign appears to float slightly or attach via an invisible mechanism, lacking clear structural logic.
